boundary.message: Something went wrong in the application. Please reload the page.

disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer:
disclaimer.body: This application provides general suggestions and does not replace medical advice. For any health concern, please consult a specialist. Recommendations are based on general information and may not be suitable for every user.

selectors.allergiesHint: Select every allergy that affects you. Recommendations will automatically exclude foods containing these allergens.
selectors.conditionsHint: Select the conditions that affect you. Recommendations will take them into account.

lactoza.label: Lactose / Dairy
lactoza.description: Allergies to dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt, etc.)

gluten.label: Gluten
gluten.description: Allergies to gluten-containing products (wheat, bread, pasta, etc.)

nuci.label: Tree nuts
nuci.description: Allergies to walnuts, hazelnuts, almonds, pistachios, etc.

oua.label: Eggs
oua.description: Allergies to eggs and egg-containing products

soia.label: Soy
soia.description: Allergies to soy and derived products (tofu, tempeh, etc.)

peste.label: Fish
peste.description: Allergies to fish and fish products

crustacee.label: Shellfish
crustacee.description: Allergies to shrimp, crab, lobster, etc.

arahide.label: Peanuts
arahide.description: Allergies to peanuts and peanut-containing products

sesam.label: Sesame
sesam.description: Allergies to sesame seeds and sesame-containing products

mustar.label: Mustard
mustar.description: Allergies to mustard and mustard-containing products

diabet.label: Diabetes
diabet.description: Requires attention to carbohydrates and glycemic index

tiroida.label: Thyroid disorders
tiroida.description: Iodine, selenium; avoid excess soy in some cases

insuficienta_renala.label: Kidney failure
insuficienta_renala.description: Limit potassium, phosphorus, protein (depending on stage)

iritații_intestinale.label: Irritable bowel syndrome
iritații_intestinale.description: Adapted fibre intake, avoid personal triggers

deficienta_b12.label: Vitamin B12 deficiency
deficienta_b12.description: Meat, fish, eggs; supplements if needed

colesterol_ridicat.label: High cholesterol
colesterol_ridicat.description: Unsaturated fats, fibre, avoid trans fats

gout.label: Gout
gout.description: Limit purines (red meat, seafood), stay hydrated

apiErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in one minute. Wait a moment and try again.
apiErrors.invalidEmail: The email address is not valid.
apiErrors.passwordBlank: The password cannot contain only spaces.
apiErrors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 6 characters long.
apiErrors.sessionMissing: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
apiErrors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
apiErrors.forbidden: You do not have access to this resource.
apiErrors.apiRouteMissing: The API route does not exist (404). Check VITE_API_URL at build time (e.g. https://backend.com/api) and that the backend service is up to date.
apiErrors.timeout: The server responded too slowly (timeout). Try again or check your connection; recommendations regenerate after you change your profile.
apiErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check that the API is running and that you are online.
apiErrors.gateway: Gateway timeout (504): the proxy or hosting cut the request short. Increase the proxy timeout or try again.
apiErrors.unavailable: Server temporarily unavailable (502/503). Please try again in a few moments.

login.heroText: Nourish your balance and let your energy return to its natural level.
login.cardSubtitle: Enter your email and password to access your account.

register.heroText: Fill in your medical profile and lab results in one simple flow, then get personalised food recommendations.

create.title: Your medical profile
create.subtitle: Fill in your details to get personalised recommendations

edit.title: Update profile
edit.subtitle: Change your personal information
edit.labsPrompt: Also update your lab results for more precise recommendations based on your values (haemoglobin, ferritin, vitamins, etc.).

fields.name: Full name
fields.caloricGoalHint: Informational only: we compare it with the recommended calories on the dashboard; it does not change the recommendations. Between {{min}} and {{max}} kcal.

errors.caloricGoalRange: The calorie goal must be between {{min}} and {{max}} kcal.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save your profile. Please try again.
errors.updateFailed: Could not save your changes. Please try again.

labs.title: Lab results
labs.subtitle: Enter the values from your recent tests (optional)
labs.noteBody: If you have no recent tests you can skip this step. You can clear any value (or all of them) and save – recommendations will update based on the new data and your profile.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save your lab results. You can continue anyway.

pdf.title: Upload a medical report (PDF)
pdf.description: attach your medical report as a PDF and the system will automatically extract the values for the available fields.
pdf.noText: Could not extract text from the PDF. The file may be scanned or protected.
pdf.nothingFound: No known values were found in the report. Please enter them manually.
pdf.extracted: Extracted {{count}} values: {{names}}. Please review and complete manually if needed.
pdf.lowConfidence: {{count}} values have low confidence — check them before saving.
pdf.failed: Could not process the PDF. Try again or enter the values manually.

notes.label: Notes or medical diagnosis
notes.placeholder: Add any notes or additional information...

recommendations.title: Your recommendations
recommendations.subtitle: Foods personalised to your nutritional needs
recommendations.empty: No recommendations found. Please check your profile and lab results.
recommendations.backgroundRefresh: The list is updating in the background; new cards appear automatically when ready.
recommendations.contentLanguageNote: Food names and detailed explanations are generated by the server in Romanian; the rest of the interface follows the language you selected.

errors.noUserId: User ID is missing. Please sign in again.
errors.noneFound: No recommendations found. Check your profile and medical lab results.
errors.retryHint: Automatic generation is being attempted. If nothing appears in a few seconds, check your profile and lab results.
errors.refreshFailed: Updating the recommendations failed. The previous list remains displayed.

updating.title: Updating recommendations
updating.body: after your profile or lab results changed. You can see the previous list below until it finishes.

categories.title: Recommended categories
categories.subtitle: You can filter the recommendations by food category.

caloric.title: Daily calorie goal
caloric.subtitle: Calories of the suggested portions, compared with your goal
caloric.noData: We have no calorie data for the recommended foods.
caloric.over: ≈ {{diff}} kcal over your goal if you ate every suggested portion.
caloric.remaining: ≈ {{diff}} kcal left until your goal if you ate every suggested portion.
caloric.disclaimer_one: Informational: sum of the calories of the suggested portions ({{count}} food), estimated from per-100 g values. It is not a meal plan and does not influence the recommendations.
caloric.disclaimer_other: Informational: sum of the calories of the suggested portions ({{count}} foods), estimated from per-100 g values. It is not a meal plan and does not influence the recommendations.
caloric.missing_one: Calorie data is missing for {{count}} food.
caloric.missing_other: Calorie data is missing for {{count}} foods.

card.kcalHint: Approximate calories of the suggested portion
card.feedbackQuestion: What do you think of this recommendation?
card.thanks: Thanks for your feedback, we use it to adjust future recommendations.

errors.feedback: Could not send your feedback. Please try again.
errors.dislike: Could not save the dislike. Please try again.
errors.replace: Could not replace the recommendation. Your dislike was recorded.

card.dislikeBody: Do you want me to swap this recommendation for an alternative that fits your needs?

pdf.subtitle: Personalised Nutrition Recommendations Report
pdf.disclaimer: These recommendations are general suggestions based on the information provided and do not replace professional medical advice. Consult a licensed doctor or dietitian before making major changes to your diet.
